# Suggested fix
Implement equals and hashCode methods in ExtendedMessageFormat that incorporate the additional registry field (and any other new fields), while also calling the superclass implementations to maintain core comparison logic.

- ExtendedMessageFormat.equals(Object)
- ExtendedMessageFormat.hashCode()
